candidate_additions.name_en: Preserve Behavioral Control Semantics Across Localization
candidate_additions.name_zh: 本地化中保留行为控制语义
candidate_additions.summary_en: Compare translated agent instructions for preserved evidence, stop, escalation, evaluation and output gates, beyond exact identifier preservation.
candidate_additions.summary_zh: 检查译文是否保留证据、停止、升级、评估和输出门槛，不止核对标识符字面值。

en.description: Preserve operational controls in agent instructions when translating or adapting prose.
en.scenario: A localized reviewer keeps the same topic and severity labels but drops a proof gate, zero-finding acceptance rule, stop condition or report evidence field.
en.mechanism: Extract canonical controls: required evidence, permitted action, stop/escalate trigger, scoring or acceptance threshold, and report fields. Map each to the translation as preserved, omitted, weakened or strengthened; inspect examples against the same conditions.
en.bad: Headings and terminology look equivalent, so mark the translation equivalent even though critical findings no longer require proof.
en.good: Build a bilingual control-by-control table with source and translation locators. Record missing/softened gates separately, compare output contracts, and require correction or explicit acceptance of every material delta before claiming parity.
en.why: Readable prose and preserved technical names can conceal changed agent behavior when a safety, evidence or evaluation gate disappears.
en.expected: A reviewer can name each material control delta and consequence, and the localized instructions retain the agreed stop, evidence and reporting behavior.
en.boundaries: This is document-pair review, not proof of runtime enforcement or efficacy. Check literal identifiers/schema/paths separately. Frozen stack/version/API examples are not current product facts.

zh.description: 翻译或改写 agent 指令时，保留其操作控制条件。
zh.scenario: 本地化 reviewer 保留主题和严重级别，却省略原文的证据门槛、零发现也可通过的规则、停止条件或报告证据字段。
zh.mechanism: 逐条抽取原文控制语句：所需证据、允许动作、停止／升级触发条件、评分或验收阈值、报告字段。将译文对应项标为保留、省略、弱化或强化，并按相同条件核对示例。
zh.bad: 标题和术语看似对应，便判定译文语义等价，即使严重问题不再要求证据。
zh.good: 制作逐项双语控制表并记录原文与译文定位。单列缺失或弱化的门槛，对照最终输出契约；在修正或明确接受每项实质差异前，不宣称语义一致。
zh.why: 即使译文易读且技术名称未变，安全、证据或评估门槛的消失仍会改变 agent 的操作行为。
zh.expected: 审查者可以指出每项实质控制差异及其影响，且本地化指令保留已约定的停止、取证和报告行为。
zh.boundaries: 这是文档对照，不证明运行时强制执行或实际效果。机器标识符／schema／路径完整性应另行检查。不得把固定版本的技术栈、版本或 API 示例当作当前产品事实。

curation_recommendations.recommendation: Consider the proposed semantic-control-parity candidate as distinct from ecc-variants-localization-symbol-integrity. The existing candidate covers literal machine identifiers, schema keys and paths; this evidence concerns preservation of readable operational gates (proof, stop/escalate, evaluation validity and report contracts). Keep it only if it remains non-duplicative of root/core localization candidates. Do not turn Japanese additions or omissions into current platform/product facts.
